content.text:
I don’t have a skill registry/list exposed directly, but in this harness I have these active capabilities:

- Codebase inspection: `read`, `find`, `search`, `ast_grep`, `lsp`
- Editing: `edit`, `write`, `ast_edit`, LSP rename/code actions
- Execution/debugging: `bash`, `debug`
- Planning/workflow: todos, checkpoints/rewind
- Delegation: subagents for explore/plan/review/oracle/task/etc.
- Web/external research: `web_search`, URL `read`
- Memory: recall/reflect/retain
- Image generation/editing
- Internal resource access: `skill://`, `rule://`, `memory://`, `agent://`, `artifact://`, `issue://`, `pr://`, etc.

Available subagent types:
- `explore`
- `plan`
- `designer`
- `reviewer`
- `librarian`
- `oracle`
- `task`
- `quick_task`

If by “skills” you mean project-specific reusable instructions under `skill://...`, I can only read one when we know its name; I don’t currently see a tool that lists all skill names.
